A '''planet'''<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-forgotten-droid-concept-art-gallery|text="The Forgotten Droid" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}}</ref> located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] was covered in a shallow [[Ocean|sea]] of [[crystal]] clear [[water]]<ref name="Helmet Collection 24" /> that featured [[coral]] growth.<ref name="Concept Art Gallery" /> Conquered by the [[Galactic Empire]], it was the site of [[Horizon Base]], a vital Imperial shipping [[Spaceport|port]] and [[Fuel|refueling]] station.<ref name="Helmet Collection 24" />
